command: python3 -m sprat.cli add-user alice analyst && python3 -m sprat.cli add-user bob analyst && A=$(python3 -m sprat.cli create alice requirement "Encrypt data at rest" --content "Alice analysis" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])') && B=$(python3 -m sprat.cli create bob requirement "Encrypt data at rest" --content "Bob analysis" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])') && python3 -m sprat.cli compare alice "$A" "$B"
